source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 11 ki exercise (PDF 259-260) hal ke saath; numerical jawab kitab ke jawabon se check kiye gaye.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Special Theory of Relativity) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; numerical problems qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
11.1 Relativistic mechanic yields results different from classical mechanics for objects moving with:
(Relativistic mechanics kin objects ke liye classical mechanics se mukhtalif nataij deti hai?)

options.text: sound waves ki velocity ke barabar velocity
light ki velocity ke qareeb velocity

blocks.explanation: Relativistic asraat (time dilation, length contraction, mass ka barhna) √(1 − v²/c²) par munhasir hain. Yeh factor sirf tab 1 se kafi kam hota hai jab v light ki speed c ke qareeb ho. Rozana ki speeds (sound ki speed bhi) par yeh taqreeban 1 hai, is liye dono mechanics ek jaise nataij deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
11.2 If an observer is moving in the same direction as a sound wave, the velocity of the wave seems to be:
(Agar observer sound wave ki simt (direction) mein hi chal raha ho to wave ki velocity kaisi lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sound ke liye velocity relative hoti hai: wave ke saath chalne wala observer v_sound − v_observer naapta hai, is liye wave dheemi lagti hai. (Light mukhtalif hai: doosre postulate ke mutabiq us ki speed har observer ke liye c hi rehti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
11.3 If the rest mass of a particle mₒ increases to m due to its high speed, then its kinetic energy is:
(Agar tez speed ki wajah se particle ka rest mass mₒ barh kar m ho jaye to us ki kinetic energy kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Total energy E = mc² aur rest mass energy Eₒ = mₒc² hai. Zaid (extra) energy harkat ki wajah se hai, is liye K.E. = mc² − mₒc² = (m − mₒ)c² (Section 11.4).

blocks.prompt:
11.4 The speed of beam light of a car while moving with high speed as compared to its rest position is:
(Tez chalti car ki light ki beam ki speed, car ke rukay hone ke muqable mein, kaisi hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre postulate ke mutabiq free space mein light ki speed har observer ke liye c hai, chahe source ya observer kaisi bhi harkat mein ho. Is liye car ki light ki speed wohi c rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
11.5 A photon is a particle of light. What is its mass when it moves with 0.9 c?
(Photon light ka particle hai. Jab yeh 0.9 c se chale to is ka mass kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Photon ka rest mass sifar hai (photon Higgs field se interact nahi karta, Section 12.7). 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg electron ka mass hai aur 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg proton ka. (Free space mein photon hamesha c se chalta hai; 0.9 c jaisi kam speed sirf kisi medium (wasta) ke andar mumkin hai.)

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
11.1 What is meant by inertial frame of reference and a non-inertial frame of reference?
Inertial aur non-inertial frame of reference se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation:
Inertial frame: woh frame jis mein law of inertia (jamood ka qanoon) laagu hota hai; yeh rest par ho ya uniform velocity se chale (misal: Zameen, uniform velocity se chalti car).
Non-inertial frame: accelerated (tez ya dheema hota) frame jis mein law of inertia laagu nahi hota (misal: car jo achanak tez ho, ruke ya mude).

blocks.prompt:
11.2 What are the two postulates of special theory of relativity?
Special theory of relativity ke do postulates (bunyadi mafrooze) kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Physics ke qawaneen tamam inertial frames mein ek jaise hain (principle of relativity).
2. Free space mein light ki speed har observer ke liye ek hi (c) hai, chahe source ya observer kaisi bhi harkat mein ho (principle of constancy of light).

blocks.prompt:
11.3 Describe why it is impossible for a material particle to move with speed of light.
Bataein ke koi material particle light ki speed se kyun nahi chal sakta.
blocks.explanation:
m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) ke mutabiq jab v → c to √(1 − v²/c²) → 0, is liye m → ∞ (la-mehdood).
La-mehdood mass ko tez karne ke liye la-mehdood force (energy) chahiye, jo mumkin nahi. Is liye material particle kabhi light ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakta.

blocks.prompt:
11.4 Does theory of relativity contradicts Newton's laws of motion? Explain briefly.
Kya theory of relativity Newton ke laws of motion ki nafi (contradict) karti hai? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Relativity Newton ki mechanics ko aage barhati hai. Jab speed c se bohat kam ho to v²/c² ≈ 0, is liye t = tₒ, ℓ = ℓₒ aur m = mₒ, yaani relativity ki equations Newton ke laws ban jati hain. Farq sirf light ki speed ke qareeb aata hai, aur wahan relativity sahi (tajrubati tor par sabit) nataij deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
11.5 What is meant by proper time, and proper length?
Proper time aur proper length se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation:
Proper time (tₒ): do events ke darmiyan waqt ka woh waqfa jo us observer ne naapa jo events wale frame mein rest par hai.
Proper length (ℓₒ): kisi cheez ki lambai (ya do points ka fasla) jo us observer ne naapi jo us ke lehaaz se rest par hai.

blocks.prompt:
11.6 What is meant by relativistic mass, length and time?
Relativistic mass, length aur time se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh woh mass, length aur time hain jo observer ke lehaaz se v speed se chalti cheez ke liye naape jayen:
Mass: m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²), rest mass se zyada.
Length: ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²), proper length se chhoti (sirf harkat ki simt mein).
Time: t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²), proper time se lamba (time dilation, waqt ka phailna).

blocks.prompt:
11.7 Why mass of a moving object increases?
Chalti hui cheez ka mass kyun barhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Special relativity ke mutabiq mass speed par munhasir hai: m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²). Speed barhne par cheez ko di gayi energy us ka mass barhati hai (E = mc²), yaani us ki inertia (jamood) barhti hai. Jab v, c ke qareeb ho to speed badalne ke liye zyada se zyada force chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
11.8 All motion are relatives. Does space-time is absolute? Explain briefly.
Har harkat relative hai. Kya space-time absolute (mutlaq) hai? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Relativity mein na space absolute hai na time: observer ke frame ke mutabiq lambai chhoti hoti hai aur waqt phailta hai. Space aur time mil kar ek chaar-dimensional (4D) continuum, space-time, bante hain jo bhaari ajsaam ke qareeb khud mur (curve) jata hai. Is liye space-time koi absolute, fixed pas-e-manzar nahi.

blocks.prompt:
11.9 Explain that speed of light is an ultimate limit for any object.
Wazahat karein ke light ki speed kisi bhi cheez ke liye aakhri had (ultimate limit) hai.
blocks.explanation: Jab kisi cheez ki speed c ke qareeb aati hai to us ka mass m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) la-mehdood ki taraf jata hai, is liye aur tez karne ke liye force ya energy bhi la-mehdood chahiye. Is liye mass wali koi cheez light ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakti, us se aage jana to door ki baat; c aakhri had hai.

blocks.prompt:
11.10 Give examples where the results of special theory of relativity have been verified.
Woh misalein dein jahan special theory of relativity ke nataij ki tasdeeq hui hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Nuclear reactions mein energy aur mass ki tabdeeli bilkul E = mc² aur Δm = ΔE/c² ke mutabiq hoti hai.
2. Accelerators mein subatomic particles: speed ke saath un ka mass barhta hai aur woh kabhi c tak nahi pohanchte.
3. Pair production aur annihilation (electron-positron pair ke liye 1.02 MeV) mass-energy equivalence ki tasdeeq karte hain.
4. Tez chalne wale unstable particles (misal: cosmic rays ke muons) rest ke muqable mein zyada der zinda rehte hain: time dilation (chapter se bahar).

blocks.text: Constructed Response Questions (wazahati jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
11.1 Speed of sound is affected by relative motion between the observer and the source. Does this apply to speed of light as well? Describe briefly.
Sound ki speed observer aur source ki relative harkat se mutasir hoti hai. Kya yeh light ki speed par bhi laagu hota hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nahi. Sound medium mein chalne wali mechanical wave hai, is liye observer ya source ki harkat se us ki naapi gayi speed badal jati hai (v_sound ± v).
Light special relativity ke doosre postulate ko follow karti hai: free space mein us ki speed har observer ke liye ek hi, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, hai, chahe source ya observer kaisi bhi harkat mein hon. Misal: chalti car ki headlight ki roshni driver aur sarak par khara shakhs dono c hi naapte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sound ke liye speeds jama/manfi hoti hain (jaise do gaariyon ki relative speed). Light ke saath aisa nahi hota: aap kitni bhi tez bhagein, roshni aap ko hamesha c hi se guzarti nazar aayegi.

blocks.prompt:
11.2 Is it ever possible to see a star moving away from us at a uniform velocity equal to the velocity of light?
Kya kabhi aisa sitara dekhna mumkin hai jo hum se light ki velocity ke barabar uniform velocity se door ja raha ho?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Sitara rest mass wala material jism hai. Light ki speed se chalne ke liye us ka mass m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) la-mehdood ho jata, jis ke liye la-mehdood energy chahiye. Is liye koi sitara light ki speed se nahi chal sakta, sirf c se kam speed se. (Us ki speed jo bhi ho, us ki roshni hum tak c hi se pohanchti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
11.3 If the speed of light is just 50 m s⁻¹, how would every day events appear to?
Agar light ki speed sirf 50 m s⁻¹ hoti to rozana ke waqiaat kaise nazar aate?
blocks.explanation:
Rozana ki speeds (car, train, jahaz) c ke qareeb hotin, is liye relativity ke asraat roz nazar aate:
1. Length contraction: chalti gaariyan harkat ki simt mein chhoti nazar aatin. 30 m s⁻¹ wali car ke liye √(1 − 30²/50²) = 0.8, yaani 5 m lambi car 4 m nazar aati.
2. Time dilation: chalte logon ki gharriyan dheemi chaltin; driver ka 1 ghanta hamare liye 1.25 ghante hota, aur tez safar karne wale aahista boorhe hote.
3. Mass ka barhna: chalti cheezein bhaari ho jatin aur tez karna mushkil hota; koi gaari 50 m s⁻¹ tak na pohanchti.
4. Simultaneity: ek observer ke liye ek saath hone wale waqiaat chalte observer ke liye ek saath na hote.
5. Waqiaat der se nazar aate: roshni ko 100 m tay karne mein 2 s lagte.

blocks.prompt:
11.4 If the speed of light were infinite, what would the equations of special theory of relativity reduce to?
Agar light ki speed la-mehdood (infinite) hoti to special relativity ki equations kya ban jatin?
blocks.explanation:
Agar c → ∞ ho to har speed ke liye v²/c² → 0, yaani √(1 − v²/c²) → 1:
t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) → t = tₒ (time dilation nahi)
ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²) → ℓ = ℓₒ (length contraction nahi)
m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) → m = mₒ (mass constant)
Equations classical (Newton ki) mechanics ki ban jatin, jis mein time, length aur mass absolute (mutlaq) hain.

blocks.prompt:
11.5 According to Einstein's equation; E = mc², is it possible to create a single electron from energy? Explain.
Einstein ki equation E = mc² ke mutabiq kya energy se sirf ek electron banaya ja sakta hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Energy mass mein badal sakti hai, lekin charge bhi conserve (mehfooz) rehna chahiye. Photon par koi charge nahi, is liye energy se akela (manfi) electron nahi ban sakta. Electron apne antiparticle positron ke saath banta hai (pair production): γ → e⁻ + e⁺. Photon ki energy kam az kam 2mₒc² = 1.02 MeV honi chahiye aur momentum conserve karne ke liye qareeb nucleus hona zaroori hai (Chapter 12, Section 12.3).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Charge pehle 0 (photon) tha, to baad mein bhi 0 hona chahiye: e⁻ (−1) + e⁺ (+1) = 0. Akela electron (−1) banta to charge ka hisaab barabar na hota.

blocks.prompt:
11.1 What is meant by the "frame of reference"? Distinguish between inertial frame of reference and non inertial frame of reference by giving examples.
"Frame of reference" se kya murad hai? Misalein de kar inertial aur non-inertial frame of reference mein farq karein.
blocks.explanation:
Frame of reference: koi bhi coordinate system jis ke lehaaz se naap (position, harkat) li jaye. Misal: mez ki jagah ke liye kamre ki deewarein, lab ke tajrubon ke liye laboratory, chalti train ke andar tajrube ke liye train, aur spaceship ki jagah ke liye door ke sitare. Rest aur harkat relative hain: chalti train ki deewarein musafiron ke liye rest par hain lekin zameen par khare shakhs ke liye harkat mein.
Inertial aur non-inertial frame ka farq table mein hai. Asal mein Zameen non-inertial hai (ghoomti aur chakkar lagati hai), lekin us ka acceleration itna kam hai ke use inertial frame maana jata hai.

rows: Is mein law of inertia (Newton ka pehla law) laagu hota hai
Is mein law of inertia laagu nahi hota
Rest par ya uniform velocity se chalta hai
Accelerated (tez hota, dheema hota ya murta hai)
Rest wali cheez rest par rehti hai jab tak unbalanced force na lage
Rest wali cheez baghair force ke harkat karti lagti hai (misal: brake par musafir aage jhatka khate hain)
Special relativity in frames se mutalliq hai
General relativity in frames se mutalliq hai
Misalein: Zameen (taqreeban), uniform velocity se chalti car ya train
Misalein: achanak rukne ya tez hone wali car, murti bus, ghoomta jhoola

blocks.prompt:
11.2 Describe the Einstein's mass-energy equation; why cannot we observe its effects in everyday life? What are its significant consequences? Give examples.
Einstein ki mass-energy equation bayan karein; is ke asraat rozana zindagi mein kyun nazar nahi aate? Is ke aham nataij kya hain? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Mass-energy equation: mass aur energy aik doosre mein badal sakte hain. m mass wali cheez ki total energy
E = mc²   (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
jahan m speed par munhasir hai. Rest par rest mass energy Eₒ = mₒc² hai. Chalti cheez ki zaid energy us ki kinetic energy hai: K.E. = mc² − mₒc² = (m − mₒ)c². Energy ki tabdeeli ΔE mass ko Δm = ΔE/c² badalti hai.
Rozana zindagi mein kyun nazar nahi aata: c² = 9 × 10¹⁶ m² s⁻² bohat bara hai, is liye rozana ki energy tabdeeliyon se mass mein itni kam tabdeeli hoti hai ke naapi nahi ja sakti. Misal: 1 kg pani ko 0 °C se 100 °C tak garam karne mein taqreeban 4.2 × 10⁵ J lagte hain, jis se mass sirf Δm = 4.2 × 10⁵/9 × 10¹⁶ ≈ 4.7 × 10⁻¹² kg badalta hai (chapter se bahar: pani ki specific heat istemal hui).
Aham nataij aur misalein:
1. Thore se mass mein bohat bari energy hai: 1 kg mass = 9 × 10¹⁶ J.
2. Nuclear reactions: fission (nuclear power plant, atom bomb) aur fusion (Sooraj aur sitare) mein nikalne wali energy mass ki kami se aati hai, bilkul E = mc² ke mutabiq.
3. Energy matter ban sakti hai: kam az kam 1.02 MeV ka photon electron-positron pair banata hai (pair production).
4. Matter energy ban sakta hai: electron aur positron mil kar 0.51 MeV ke do gamma photons ban jate hain (annihilation).
5. Particles ki rest mass energy: misal electron ki rest mass energy 0.51 MeV hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: c² itna bara number hai ke chhoti si mass bhi bohat energy ke barabar hai, lekin ulta yeh bhi sach hai: rozana ki energy (garam karna, daurna) se mass mein itni mamooli tabdeeli hoti hai ke koi tarazu use naap nahi sakta.

blocks.prompt:
11.3 State the Einstien's concept about the space-time. Describe the view of gravity according to this concept.
Space-time ke baare mein Einstein ka tasawwur bayan karein. Is tasawwur ke mutabiq gravity ko bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Space-time ka tasawwur:
1. Space teen-dimensional (3D) phailao hai jis mein tamam cheezein aur waqiaat hote hain; time waqiaat ki tarteeb aur muddat naapta hai aur chautha dimension maana jata hai.
2. Relativity mein time absolute nahi; space aur time aapas mein jure hain aur mil kar ek chaar-dimensional continuum, space-time, bante hain, jo space aur time ke tamam points aur un ke rishton ko bayan karne wala mathematical model hai.
3. Space-time khaas tor par bhaari ajsaam ke qareeb (aur c ke qareeb speeds par) mura hua (curved) hai. Ise khinchi hui kapre ki chadar samjhein jo bhaari gaind rakhne se neeche dab jati hai; jitna bhaari jism, utna gehra jhukao.
Gravity ka tasawwur:
1. Gravity ko cheezon ko khenchne wali force nahi maana jata; yeh mass ki wajah se space-time ka murna (curvature) hai.
2. Ajsaam aur roshni ki shuaaein geodesics (mure hue space-time ki 'seedhi lakeerein') par chalti hain. Bhaari jism ke qareeb rest par ya aahista chalti cheez geodesic par us ki taraf jati hai, jise hum gravity ki kashish samajhte hain; sayyara Sooraj ke gird geodesic par chalta hai.
3. Yeh theory batati hai ke gravity inverse square law kyun follow karti hai (bohat taqatwar fields ke ilawa), jo Newton nahi bata saka tha, aur aam fields mein Newton wale nataij hi deti hai; is liye yeh Newton ki theory se aage ki theory hai.
Saboot: 1919 ke suraj grehan mein Sooraj ke qareeb se guzarti sitaron ki roshni ka murna (1.745 seconds of arc, jaisa Einstein ne kaha tha) aur 2015 mein gravitational waves (space-time ki lehrein) ka pata chalna, jis ka elaan 2016 mein hua.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Trampoline par bhaari gaind rakhein to kapra neeche dab jata hai; ab chhoti golyan khud-ba-khud us gaind ki taraf lurhakti hain. Einstein ke mutabiq gravity bhi isi tarah hai: Sooraj space-time ko mor deta hai aur sayyare us mor par chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
11.1 An electron is accelerated to a speed of 0.995 c which passes down an evacuated tube 500 m long. How long will the tube appear to the electron? (Ans: 50 m)
Electron ko 0.995 c speed tak tez kiya jata hai aur woh 500 m lambi khali (evacuated) tube se guzarta hai. Electron ko tube kitni lambi nazar aayegi?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: tube ki proper length ℓₒ = 500 m, v = 0.995 c
Maloom karna: electron ko nazar aane wali length ℓ = ?
Formula: ℓ = ℓₒ √(1 − v²/c²)
ℓ = 500 m × √(1 − (0.995 c)²/c²)
ℓ = 500 m × √(1 − 0.990025)
ℓ = 500 m × √0.009975
ℓ = 500 m × 0.0999
ℓ = 49.9 m ≈ 50 m
Jawab: electron ko tube taqreeban 50 m lambi nazar aati hai (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tube lab mein rest par hai, is liye 500 m us ki proper length hai. Electron ke lehaaz se tube chal rahi hai, is liye use tube chhoti (contracted) nazar aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
11.2 A neutron, being not a stable particle, disintigerates in 20 minutes on the average. How long will it seem to exist if shoots out from a nucleus with a speed of 0.8 c? (Ans: 33.3 min)
Neutron stable particle nahi, ausatan 20 minute mein toot jata hai. Agar yeh nucleus se 0.8 c speed se nikle to kitni der tak mojood lagega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: proper time tₒ = 20 min, v = 0.8 c
Maloom karna: observer ka naapa hua waqt t = ?
Formula: t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²)
t = 20 min/√(1 − (0.8 c)²/c²)
t = 20 min/√(1 − 0.64)
t = 20 min/√0.36
t = 20 min/0.6
t = 33.3 min
Jawab: neutron 33.3 min tak mojood lagta hai (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.prompt:
11.3 A spaceship is measured 100 m long while it is at rest with respect to an observer, if this spaceship now flies by the observer with a speed of 0.99 c, what length will the observer find for the spaceship? (Ans: 14 m)
Observer ke lehaaz se rest par spaceship 100 m lamba naapa gaya. Agar ab yeh 0.99 c speed se observer ke paas se guzre to observer us ki lambai kitni payega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: ℓₒ = 100 m, v = 0.99 c
Maloom karna: ℓ = ?
Formula: ℓ = ℓₒ √(1 − v²/c²)
ℓ = 100 m × √(1 − (0.99 c)²/c²)
ℓ = 100 m × √(1 − 0.9801)
ℓ = 100 m × √0.0199
ℓ = 100 m × 0.141
ℓ = 14.1 m ≈ 14 m
Jawab: observer ko spaceship taqreeban 14 m lamba milta hai (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.prompt:
11.4 The rest mass of an electron is 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg. Calculate the corresponding rest-mass energy. (Ans: 8.2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J or 0.51 MeV)
Electron ka rest mass 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg hai. Is ki rest-mass energy maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: mₒ = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: rest mass energy Eₒ = ?
Formula: Eₒ = mₒc²
Eₒ = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)²
Eₒ = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ × 9 × 10¹⁶ J
Eₒ = 8.2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J
Electron volt mein (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J):
Eₒ = 8.2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J/1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J eV⁻¹ = 5.1 × 10⁵ eV
Eₒ = 0.51 MeV
Jawab: Eₒ = 8.2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J = 0.51 MeV (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.prompt:
11.5 An electron is accelerated to a speed v = 0.85 c. Calculate its total energy and kinetic energy in electron volt. (Ans: 0.97 MeV, 0.459 MeV)
Electron ko v = 0.85 c speed tak tez kiya jata hai. Is ki total energy aur kinetic energy electron volt mein maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: v = 0.85 c, electron ki rest mass energy Eₒ = mₒc² = 0.511 MeV (Sawal 11.4: 0.51 MeV)
Maloom karna: total energy E = ?, kinetic energy K.E. = ?
Formulas: E = mc² = mₒc²/√(1 − v²/c²) aur K.E. = E − mₒc²
√(1 − v²/c²) = √(1 − (0.85)²) = √(1 − 0.7225) = √0.2775 = 0.527
E = 0.511 MeV/0.527
E = 0.970 MeV ≈ 0.97 MeV
K.E. = E − mₒc² = 0.970 MeV − 0.511 MeV
K.E. = 0.459 MeV
Jawab: total energy = 0.97 MeV (9.7 × 10⁵ eV); kinetic energy = 0.459 MeV (4.59 × 10⁵ eV), kitab ke jawab jaise.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan 1/2 mv² istemal nahi hota, kyunke speed c ke qareeb hai; relativistic K.E. = (m − mₒ)c² hi sahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
11.6 At what speed, would the mass of a proton in a particle accelerator be tripled? (Ans: 0.943 c)
Particle accelerator mein proton ka mass kis speed par teen guna ho jayega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: m = 3mₒ
Maloom karna: v = ?
Formula: m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²)
3mₒ = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²)
√(1 − v²/c²) = 1/3
1 − v²/c² = 1/9
v²/c² = 1 − 1/9 = 8/9 = 0.889
v = √0.889 c
v = 0.943 c (= 2.83 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)
Jawab: v = 0.943 c (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Dono taraf ka square lene se pehle mₒ cancel ho jata hai; is liye jawab proton ke mass par nahi, sirf 'teen guna' par munhasir hai. Har cheez ka mass 0.943 c par teen guna hoga.

blocks.prompt:
11.7 The period of pendulum is measured to be 3 s in an inertial frame of reference. What will be the period measured by an observer in a spaceship with a constant speed of 0.95 c with respect to the pendulum? (Ans: 9.6 s)
Inertial frame mein pendulum ka period 3 s naapa gaya. Pendulum ke lehaaz se 0.95 c constant speed se chalte spaceship mein observer kitna period naapega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: proper time tₒ = 3 s, v = 0.95 c
Maloom karna: t = ?
Formula: t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²)
t = 3 s/√(1 − (0.95)²)
t = 3 s/√(1 − 0.9025)
t = 3 s/√0.0975
t = 3 s/0.312
t = 9.6 s
Jawab: observer 9.6 s ka period naapta hai (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.prompt:
11.8 Hypothetically, if a ball of mass 0.5 kg is projected with a velocity of 0.9 c, what will be its mass in flight? (Ans: 1.15 kg)
Farz karein 0.5 kg mass ki gaind 0.9 c velocity se phenki jaye to urte waqt us ka mass kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: mₒ = 0.5 kg, v = 0.9 c
Maloom karna: m = ?
Formula: m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²)
m = 0.5 kg/√(1 − (0.9)²)
m = 0.5 kg/√(1 − 0.81)
m = 0.5 kg/√0.19
m = 0.5 kg/0.436
m = 1.15 kg
Jawab: urte waqt mass 1.15 kg hai (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).
